name: Autosomal Anomaly Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of a confirmed autosomal chromosomal structural or numerical anomaly via genetic testing
Characteristic craniofacial dysmorphic features including hypertelorism, micrognathia, and broad nasal bridge
Global developmental delay or intellectual disability apparent in early childhood
Presence of congenital cardiovascular malformations such as ventricular septal defect
Pre- or postnatal growth retardation with height and weight below the 5th percentile

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of chromosomal abnormality plus at least two major clinical features
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires genetic confirmation and clinical correlation with phenotypic features.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Autosomal chromosomal structural anomaly confirmed by karyotyping

global developmental delay from early age

laboratory: Karyotype analysis revealing autosomal chromosomal anomalies
Chromosomal microarray confirming copy number variations
imaging: Skeletal X-rays showing clinodactyly and other anomalies
genetic: Detection of autosomal numerical or structural chromosomal abnormalities
Array CGH or FISH confirming microdeletions or duplications

distinguishingFeatures: Characteristic facial features distinct from autosomal anomaly syndrome
Higher prevalence of specific congenital heart defects like atrioventricular septal defect
Short stature with webbed neck and lymphedema

redFlags: Severe congenital heart defects requiring urgent intervention
